entry.title: Enter the device code
entry.description: Your desktop app or terminal shows a 6-character code. Enter it here.
entry.footnote: No code on screen? Go back to the device and start authorization again.

errors.invalid: That code does not exist or has already been used. Check the 6-character code shown on the device.

approve.title: Allow this device to access your AgentRe account?
approve.risk: Once you approve it, this device gets full access to your AgentRe account as you, including running arbitrary code and commands. Only approve devices you trust.
approve.verify: Check that this code matches exactly what the device shows
approve.expiryAnnounce: This authorization request expires in about {{minutes}} minutes
approve.expiryAnnounceSoon: This authorization request expires in less than a minute
approve.fineprint: You can revoke this device's access at any time under Console → Devices.
approve.actionError: That did not go through. Please try again.

success.title: Device authorized
success.body: You can close this page now and continue on the device.
success.manageDevices: Go to the console to manage devices

expiredScreen.title: Authorization request expired
expiredScreen.body: Go back to the device, start authorization again, then enter the new code.

install.downloadBody: Download the installer for that platform from GitHub Releases (macOS .dmg / Windows .exe / Linux .deb).

login.agentredDesc: Signing in has to finish before the background service starts.
login.desktopTitle: Install the desktop app and sign in
login.desktopDesc: In the app, go to Settings → Remote → Sign in and enter the address below.

service.agentredTitle: Keep agentred running in the background
service.agentredDesc: Do this only after the device is approved — a service that starts earlier overwrites this login.
service.desktopDesc: The desktop app has agentred built in; it is online whenever the app is open.

manage.loadError: Could not load your devices. Please try again.
manage.revokeConfirmBody: This device can no longer refresh its credentials after you confirm. If it is offline right now, credentials already issued may still be accepted for their short validity window — revocation is not instant.
manage.revokeError: Could not revoke this device. Please try again.
manage.noProjectsReported: No projects reported from this device yet.
manage.noRunnableAgents: No agents can run on this device yet.
manage.detailLoadError: Could not load this device's details.
manage.desktopAppNotRunningDetail: Agentre is not running on this computer. Open Agentre to view its conversations.

upgrade.blockedBody: This machine is online, but its conversations stay out of reach until agentred is upgraded there.
upgrade.availableBody: Upgrading restarts agentred: conversations running on it are interrupted, and what they already produced is kept.

confirm.title: {{count}} conversation(s) still running
confirm.body: Upgrading restarts agentred, so those turns are interrupted. What they already produced is kept.

status.requestingBody: That machine is fetching and verifying the new version — this can take a few minutes. Leave this open.
status.upgradingBody: Restarting once — usually under a minute.
status.timeoutBody: Waited 5 minutes. If it isn't running as a service or container, it won't restart on its own after the upgrade.

upgrade.devBuildBody: Its version cannot be compared with a release, so it is never nudged to upgrade.
